author: Numberz_
body:
Note: Writing this to have the punishments removed/appeal from my sisters account, the two warns are both false and my sister doesn't want them on her account.

When appealing for a temp-ban/ban on the Avicus Network please include the following: 
  • Your Minecraft username(most recent name if changed) PrincessMars
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned - False warn, then a second one to attempt to make up for the first. >_<
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. - Just want to the warns removed from the history.

Any post that does not follow this guideline will be automatically locked. Also try not to spam us with 1000 appeals either. It doesn't help.

There are some things to think about before making an appeal.
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false? Yes, I was using her account I had made a joke in game after getting killed by zaidms, I said "zaid u haker xd" and Upsoar warned me.
  • Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false? - TheRomanTrident agreed it was false at the time, I do have evidence which I can get if its really needed.
  • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned? -
  • Have I been caught ban evading? Lolno ban evading a warn.
  • Have I appealed a ban before? No.

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello,

Due to the fact that both infractions are invalid, and no evidence was provided. I have decided to appeal both infractions. Enjoy your day!

Thanks,
Iron,
Avicus Network Senior Mod
